status: The layout spec for the Vivarium's whole, slot V (the Vivarium, whole and up close) of lvgl-switch.md §3: every drawn region names its word or composition, the states rest and empty, the conditions docked and away, the focus as data, the events, the bottom line, the strings and the masters
note: The one home of the numbers of the Vivarium's whole, transcribed from station-layouts.md (The Vivarium: the whole and one mibi up close) and its wireframes 18-vivarium-whole.svg to 18b-vivarium-whole-empty.svg. Rectangles are [x, y, w, h] in screen pixels; `at` offsets are from the region's own origin. The whole is the living window edge to edge, the residents walking in it, the with-you bed at its right, and the strip of bays along the foot; nothing else is on the stage. Its closer level is one mibi up close (habitat.json).
purpose: Every mibi at home, at its size, alive in one full-width window, and every bay along the foot: the player sees the whole household (who is home, who is out with the Companion, how many bays are free) and chooses one mibi to come closer to, with one press. Home's panel is the same place in a glance among the device's sections; Idle is the same painting with no frame and nothing to choose; the whole is the place with the keys in hand. Reads first: the residents; then the bays

notes.motion: Reduced motion (props.motion false; UI designer, 2026-10-10 02:29): every event on this screen is a cut to its end, so the host sends hold 0 and runs what follows an event's end (a hand-off, a jump, the next state) on the frame of the key; nothing waits on a still frame. look and back are cuts to the other level. A press that ends an event with `cut: true` also acts (habitat.json notes.cut); no event here cuts.
notes.painting: the window shows rows 120 to 560 of Idle's painting (frame.json idle.regions.vivarium.theWhole) at 1:1: one painting a light, never cropped and enlarged; a resident at y on Idle stands at y − 80 here
notes.strip: the same strip, at the same rectangle and with the same tile forms, as one mibi up close (habitat.json regions.strip and tiles): going one level closer or back keeps the strip and the ring's tile where they stood
notes.nothing else: no card, no modules, no stamp, no words in the window but the focused resident's name tag; nothing is amber
notes.residents: every mibi at home walks; the carried set sleeps on the bed while the Companion is docked (each sleeper a resident target, with no lift); while it is away, the bed shows the Companion mark and the carried mibis are only on the strip, each tile with the outline glyph
notes.paintingLands: a painting that lands while its mibi is on screen waits for the next fresh draw (the whole opened again, a wake): never a swap in view

rules.closedList: station-layouts.md, The derived rules (closed): railCompaction slantTabs pageGrid platePosition listPitch splicePlan guideColumns pipGroups leafArc
rules.listPitch: the strip's tiles, by habitat.json regions.tiles.forms: n bays take the form with the smallest upTo at least n

conditions.docked: the Companion in the Caddy: the carried set asleep on the bed, their tiles thumbnails
conditions.away: the Companion out: the bed shows the Companion mark, the carried mibis' tiles show the outline glyph
conditions.dock: Dock while the whole shows: the bed's Companion mark goes and the carried set lies down on it; their tiles' outline glyphs become thumbnails. Lifted: the reverse. Both on the frame of the world event, with no animation

initial: by the save: no housed mibi, empty; else rest
stateRule: rest: at least one housed mibi (at home or out with the Companion). empty: no housed mibi; the window, the strip's free bays and the frame. A region with `inStates` exists only in those states; docked and away are conditions of both

stage.note: the window covers the stage's top; the ground shows round the strip (y 480 to 562)

painting.source: Idle's painting (frame.json idle.regions.vivarium), one a light: the art director's ruling, its rows 120 to 560 are the whole's window
painting.rule: rows 120 to 560 of Idle's painting at 1:1

window.until: the placeholder: back `forest`, ground band `clay` with a `sand` top row, foot `soil`
window.note: edge to edge, no bezel; no words inside but the focused resident's name tag

walk.rule: each walks with its feet in the band, as on Idle 80 px higher

resident.order: by the feet's y, lower in front (drawn later), left first on a tie; the bed and its sleepers sort as one, at the bed's foot (y 472)
resident.props: per resident: mibi id, stage, painting or placeholder, waiting, seed; the face steps the walk, as on Home and Idle; each walks, rests and plays its species' idle on that seed, as on Home and Idle; the focused one stops while it is focused, lifted 4 px

ink.rule: the nap pose's ink is at most 96 wide and 88 tall, centred on footX and bottom-aligned on footY: at most [footX − 48, 368, 96, 88]; three sit on the 192 px bed (792 to 984)

sleepers.focus: each sleeper is a resident target, with the feet ring and no lift

states.docked: the nest, then one to three sleepers, the carried set in carried order
states.away: the nest, then the Companion mark at markRect
states.none: docked with nobody carried: the nest drawn empty at the bed's rect (its rim `bark`, hollow `soil`, lit rim `sand`), no sleeper and no mark; not a target

bed.note: Idle's bed (frame.json idle.regions.bed) 80 px higher: the same place in the same painting

nameTag.when: a resident or a sleeper is focused; never otherwise
nameTag.w: the name's width + 16, rounded up to 8, at least 48; the widest name (160 px at 16) gives 176
nameTag.y: top at feet + 24, 12 px under the feet ring; if its bottom would pass y 472 (8 px inside the window), it sits over the resident: top = box.y − 4 − 32; a sleeper's tag is always over it: top = box.y − 32
nameTag.x: centred on the resident's box, slid to stay 8 px inside the window (8 to 1016)
nameTag.note: Home's tag (home.json regions.nameTag), the same size: the residents are Home's size

tile.fill: a panel rect in the tile's box
tile.free: a composed `dash` outline round the tile's box, 1 px `hairline`, dash [2, 2]; not a target
tile.out: the outline Companion glyph (outGlyph) centred where the thumbnail stands
tile.note: the same forms and tile as habitat.json regions.tiles

tiles.count: one tile a bay (state.bayCount, 1 to 12): the housed mibis in bay order, then the free bays
tiles.noShown: the whole shows no mibi up close, so no tile is `shown`: the ring is the only highlight

drawOrder: residents and the bed (by the feet's y)

look.do: ✓ on a resident or a tile: the frame's screen transition to one mibi up close (habitat.json), that mibi shown, the ring on it (its name tag when it is out with the Companion)

back.do: ← from one mibi up close lands here, the ring on that mibi's resident, else its tile

focus.room: only in the empty state: the ring on nothing, no ring drawn; ✓ does nothing (no ✓ cap)

entry.homePanel: Home's ✓ Open the Vivarium: the mibi last seen up close, its resident, else its tile; none seen yet, the first resident in bay order; none at home, the first tile; none housed, room
entry.vivariumKey: the same as homePanel (frame.json navigation.roomKeys, station-layouts.md The column and the keys)
entry.backFromMibi: ← from one mibi up close: that mibi's resident, else its tile
entry.wake: the screen under Idle, its focus as it was

selectors.tile.of: the focused resident's own tile; every housed mibi has one, so it is never null
selectors.resident.of: the focused tile's mibi's resident; for a mibi out with the Companion, null, and the selector rule of lvgl-switch.md §2.6.1 takes the first resident in the list (the first at home in bay order)

focus.primitives: lvgl-switch.md §2.6.1 governs: the edge forms, the order of a move and the integer scores on doubled centres; `axis` walks the group's present targets by index and stops at the ends

resident.box: the resident's box where the face has stepped it; each sleeper is one, with no lift

tile.present: rest, every housed mibi, at home or out; free bays are not targets

focus.list: the order the view lists the targets: the residents in bay order (sleepers in their bays' places), then the tiles in bay order
focus.held: while events.look or events.back holds, the face moves no focus and sends no intent but room:<x> (kept by the host and dispatched when the hold ends)

layout.note: the targets the vectors are played on: the wireframe 18, eight bays, seven mibis, docked, Pip and Sorrel asleep on the bed

vectors.note: Pip is out: resident.of is null, and the selector takes the first resident in the list
an out mibi's tile is a target

keys.confirm: the bottom line's action: on a resident or a tile, one mibi up close (events.look)
keys.back: Home, the ring on the vivarium panel (home.json, ← from a section)
keys.vivarium: on the whole, the ring back by focus.entry.vivariumKey
keys.dock: the Caddy's Dock, a world event: events.dock; no message plate

resident.context: strings.resident; a sleeper strings.sleeper; while the placeholder is drawn, strings.painting

bottomLine.notice: the frame's notice only (what needs the player anywhere); nothing on the whole sets one

frameZones.title: strings.title, after the Vivarium key's icon (frame-room-vivarium-24)
frameZones.companion: the top bar's Companion zone (station-layouts.md The frame): the glyph and its lamp, then three face places in carried order at (800, 8), (828, 8) and (856, 8), 24×24

masters.note: every picture the whole names, at the size it is shown; none is drawn by the build, and the whole needs no new master
list: Idle's painting 1024×568, day, dusk and night (frame.json idle; rows 120 to 560 shown here)
the residents at 144×152 and 104×112, and the nap poses (as on Home and Idle)
frame-companion-outline-16x24 (the bed's mark and the out tile's glyph)
the thumbnails 48×48 (the painting or placeholder rendered at that size)

strings.title: Vivarium
strings.painting: its painting is on its way
strings.measured: 16 px Inter, the face's metrics (prototypes/face/tests/vectors/metrics.json), a name as ten of the widest letter (160): look 220 in the action's 356; in the context's 208: painting 176, sleeper 174 ("an elder Untuva, asleep"), empty 160, out 177; back 45 in its 68; title 85 at 20 px
strings.note: the frame's zones (station-layouts.md, The frame): a verb phrase of four words or fewer, a context of six or fewer; Home's words where Home says the same thing (home.json strings.actions.resident, strings.subjects)

buildChanges: frame.json navigation: a new place `vivarium` (parent home, back Home) for the whole; `habitat` (one mibi up close) moves under it (parent vivarium, back Vivarium); the Vivarium key (roomKeys.habitat) opens `vivarium`, not `habitat`; Home's ✓ Open the Vivarium opens `vivarium`. nav.mjs, nav.test.mjs and the journey follow
the whole is a new screen: its binding table, its view's props (residents, bed, tiles) and its intents; it reuses Home's resident walk, the withYouBed build and habitat.json's bayStrip
